# yolog

> Git for your agents: the whole agent (identity, skills, memory, logs, plans, files, runs and decisions) as an append-only history of checkpoints and branches. Hosted at api.yolog.dev (free tier: sign up by email code; people read it at app.yolog.dev), or self-hosted on your machine or Cloudflare account. Exports as plain Git.

To set up yolog for a project, follow https://yolog.dev/agents.md step by step.

## Docs

- [Set up yolog for this project](https://yolog.dev/agents.md): step-by-step instructions for an agent: sign up for the free tier by email code and connect the project
- [Connect a coding agent (MCP)](https://docs.yolog.dev/guides/connect-an-agent/): yolog's tools for Claude Code, Codex and other MCP clients at https://api.yolog.dev/mcp, nothing to install
- [View in a browser](https://docs.yolog.dev/guides/view-in-a-browser/): a read-only viewer at https://app.yolog.dev; a person signs in with the token in `.yolog/token`
- [Quick start](https://docs.yolog.dev/start/quick-start/): run yolog locally and publish two checkpoints
- [Deploy to Cloudflare](https://docs.yolog.dev/start/deploy-to-cloudflare/): run yolog in your own Cloudflare account
- [HTTP API](https://docs.yolog.dev/reference/http-api/): every endpoint, with request and answer shapes
- [Tokens and scopes](https://docs.yolog.dev/reference/tokens-and-scopes/): which token can do what
- [JavaScript client](https://docs.yolog.dev/reference/javascript-client/)
- [Rust client](https://docs.yolog.dev/reference/rust-client/): the `yolog` crate on crates.io

## Optional

- [Save a conversation log](https://docs.yolog.dev/guides/save-a-conversation-log/)

- [A platform with many users](https://docs.yolog.dev/guides/multi-user-platform/)
